findings.description: The RDS instance explicitly sets storage_encrypted = false, leaving database storage, snapshots, and backups unencrypted at rest.

The RDS instance sets publicly_accessible = true, assigning it a publicly reachable database endpoint. Although the shown security-group ingress is limited to the VPC CIDR, this unnecessarily exposes the database to internet routing and weakens network segmentation.
This rule permits all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0 from the database security group, allowing unrestricted outbound network access rather than limiting traffic to required destinations.

The EC2 instance role is granted s3:*, ec2:*, and rds:* on every resource. Any compromise of aws_instance.db_app would yield broad account-level capabilities, including potential data access, infrastructure modification, and privilege-escalation paths.

The DB password is interpolated into EC2 user_data and written as plaintext PHP configuration. User data is retrievable by processes with instance metadata access and is retained in Terraform state, exposing the database credential.
